scope: preexisting source-only reproducibility repairs discovered by the starting validation

repairs.observed_failure: inspect.getfile raised for a valid Python namespace package with no __file__
repairs.repair: validate every discoverable __file__ or __path__ location against the frozen source root

repairs.observed_failure: a fast synthetic backend produced a zero empirical dispatch interval and divided by it while reconstructing delivery age
repairs.repair: fall back to the declared controller period for a nonpositive or nonfinite empirical step duration

repairs.observed_failure: repository-wide Ruff reported F841 for the deliberately parsed M5 configuration payload
repairs.repair: rename the otherwise unused local to _config while preserving the same required JSON read and validation
repairs.regression_test: repository-wide Ruff plus the complete 350-test Python and ROS-source suite

interpretation: These repairs restore deterministic execution of already accepted tests. They do not change, regenerate, or reinterpret any M3-M7 raw result.
